title: The Map and the Fan
lines: Sam and Pam sat at a fan.
A tan map is at Sam.
The fan is at the map.
Tip! The map is in the pit!
Tim! Tip the map at Sam!
Sam and Pam pat the map.
Sit at the fan, Tim. Sip, sip, sip.

questions.ask: What made the map tip into the pit?
questions.listenFor: The fan, blowing on it. Lines three and four say it. Let your child read them again instead of you giving the answer.

questions.ask: Who got the map back out of the pit?
questions.listenFor: Tim. He was sitting right at the pit. If your child says Sam, ask them who the map got tipped to, and who did the tipping.

questions.ask: Where would you keep that map so it stays safe? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any place is fine. You are listening for a reason that shows they understood the fan was the problem, like away from the fan.
